description: This is a Perl script implementing a minimal pass-through Git filter protocol version 2, handling packet communication between Git and the filter, including capabilities negotiation and command processing for 'clean' and 'smudge' operations.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN, handling packet size and content.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text line packet, ensuring it ends with LF.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT with size prefix.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text line packet to STDOUT.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Flushes the packet stream by sending a zero-length packet.
